about: Generic fixture world for the mixed card and specification cases. The records are the spec_selection fixture index (spec_selection/fixture_index.json) plus the extra records below; the cards and the tag table are invented here. No real person, team or account.

note-release-checklist.name: Release checklist
note-release-checklist.summary: Note: before publishing the package, tag the version, update the changelog, build the wheel and upload it.

runbook-card-backend-outage.name: Runbook: card backend outage
runbook-card-backend-outage.summary: Runbook for when the hosted card service is unreachable: confirm the outage, keep serving the cached card listing, and replay the held card writes once the service answers again.

file-staleness-check.name: staleness_check.py
file-staleness-check.summary: Compares the content hash of each card's source files with the stored fingerprint and lists the cards whose sources changed or were deleted.

note-onboarding.name: Welcoming a new teammate
note-onboarding.summary: Steps for someone who joins the team: create their accounts, pair them with a buddy, and give them a small first task in their first week.

conversation-annual-discount.name: Conversation: pricing page discount
conversation-annual-discount.summary: Past conversation about the pricing page: we discussed moving everyone to monthly plans and decided to keep the annual discount for now.

note-misrouted-question.name: Note: a plain question started a deep run
note-misrouted-question.summary: Observed twice this week: a plain question about a goal's due date was routed to an expensive autonomous deep run instead of a short answer.

note-weekly-standup.name: Weekly standup format
note-weekly-standup.summary: Each person says what they finished, what they are doing next and what blocks them; ten minutes, cameras optional.

file-billing-export.name: billing_export.py
file-billing-export.summary: Exports the month's invoices to a CSV file for the accountant.

conversation-settings-colours.name: Conversation: settings screen colours
conversation-settings-colours.summary: Past conversation reviewing the colour palette and contrast of the settings screen.

runbook-rotate-api-key.name: Runbook: rotate a service key
runbook-rotate-api-key.summary: How to rotate a service API key: create the new key, update the deployment secret, then revoke the old key.

note-travel-policy.name: Travel policy
note-travel-policy.summary: Book trains over flights for trips under four hours; submit receipts within a month.

extra_records.title: Scheduled reminders arrive in the wrong time zone
extra_records.summary: Reminders a person scheduled arrive in the wrong time zone, so a nudge meant for the morning lands in the middle of the night.

extra_records.title: Household meals planned from the pantry
extra_records.summary: Every household meal of the week is planned ahead from what is already in the pantry.

extra_records.title: Pantry food expires unused
extra_records.summary: Food in the cupboard expires unused because nobody knows what is there when the shopping list is written.

tag_table.about: A fixture tag (not esoi/tags.csv): store-layout marks the solutions that read or write cards by their stored layout, so a change to that layout must change them (R3).
